Exactly right! Yes, since it's a live plant replacement, it will only ship **Monday to Wednesday**.

So once the courier investigation confirms the package is lost (up to **5 business days**), and you confirm you want the replacement, it will ship on the next available plant shipping day — which could be Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday of that week.

**To get started:**
I just need your **order number** (`LF-` followed by six digits, e.g. LF-204518). Please don't send any full card numbers, security codes, or passwords.

Once I have that, we'll open the investigation and get this sorted for you. Thanks so much for your patience, and please reach out any time you need us!
